title: harness.config.json
description: What layer A needs to know about one consuming repository. Layer A is authored once and identical everywhere; every stack fact it depends on is declared here, so the shared half never has to name a toolchain, a directory or a team key. One file per repository, at its root — a scaffolded product repo with two apps declares one per app.

name.description: This repository's name, as it appears in prose and in review output.

tracker.description: Issue-tracker facts. The doctrine is in docs/agents/issue-tracker.md; only the keys that identify this repo's project belong here.

team.description: Team key, as it appears in issue ids and in branch names (`<type>/<TEAM>-<num>-<slug>`).

install.description: Bring dependencies up to date. Run before a gate when the lockfile or manifest changed.

dev.description: The development server, for /run. Omit in a repo that has none.

readyCheck.description: One sentence naming what to confirm before reporting success — a route that must respond, a page that must render.

gates.description: The Definition of Done, as commands. This is the single declaration of what must be green: /lint, /test, the verify hook and the meta-repo's cross-stack job all read it, so a gate added here is added everywhere at once.

name.description: How the gate is named in output. Usually the tool.

kind.description: What the gate checks. /lint runs lint+format+types, /test runs test, and e2e and integration are opt-in — they need a browser or a container and are not part of the default local loop.

when.description: One sentence naming when this gate is required, for the kinds that are not always run. Omit for a gate that always applies.

caveat.description: One sentence naming how this gate can pass without having checked anything — a linter rule that fails open on an unclassified file, a metric the runner could not measure, a suite that silently collected nothing. /verify prints it beside the green result. A gate whose vacuous pass is undocumented is worse than a missing gate, because it is trusted.

review.description: What /full-review needs that layer A cannot know. The reviewer frames are shared; the checklists they read are this repo's.

agentDir.description: Where this repo keeps its own subagent definitions. Searched after the plugin's, so a stack definition — the ninth axis — resolves, and a stack may override a shared frame deliberately.

checklistDir.description: Where this repo keeps the stack half of each shared subagent, one file per agent name.

ninthAxis.description: The axis that is this stack's alone. Eight axes are shared; the ninth is the one the other stack has no equivalent for, and it is a whole definition rather than a frame plus a checklist.

styleEnforcedBy.description: The tools that already own style, named as prose. The synthesiser is told to drop any finding these enforce, because a reviewer repeating the linter is noise.

argv.description: A command as argv, never as a shell string. A string would have to be parsed by a shell, and the one thing a config file must not do is decide how its own values get quoted.
